title: Short, strange-looking police officer escorts Michael off restricted land

tellings.quote: He was short. He was short. Face was puffy. He had a hat on. Deputy dog kind of hat like a deputy dog kind of hat from cartoons and stuff.

plain: A former truck driver, known only as Michael, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that around 1977, after a UFO sighting and a stretch of time he cannot account for, he ended up on restricted government land in Nevada. He says a police officer escorted him off, and that the man looked strange: short, with a puffy face and a hat like the one worn by the cartoon character Deputy Dawg. He tells it because the officer seemed not quite like an ordinary person, which would hint that something unusual was guarding that land.
